versions.content: If an Ethernet frame has been received and the Ethernet frame passes the Egress filtering, then the Ethernet frame shall be forwarded to the Egress port according the EthSwtVlanForwardingType configuration: • If egress port is configured to ETHSWT_SENT_TAGGED , then the Ethernet frame shall be transmitted with a VLAN tag, • else If egress port is configured to ETHSWT_SENT_UNTAGGED , then the Ethernet frame shall be transmitted without a VLAN tag, • else if egress port is configured to ETHSWT_NOT_SENT , then the Ethernet frame shall be dropped
